Title: C# Inheritance
Description: In C#, it is possible to inherit fields and methods from one class to another.

Challenges.Title: Base class
Challenges.Exercise: Create a `Vehicle` class with a `honk()` method.

Challenges.Title: Derived class
Challenges.Exercise: Create a `Car` class that inherits from `Vehicle`.

Challenges.Title: Add field
Challenges.Exercise: Add a string field `modelName` to the `Car` class.

Challenges.Title: Instantiate
Challenges.Exercise: In the main logic, create an object of `Car`.
